text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I lost yet again...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I got special permission to come and
race in
Japan, and this is all I have to
show for it. It's
rather pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was naive. No matter how much fun I
have
running, that's not enough to get
results...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was naive. No matter how much fun I
have
running, that's not enough to get
results...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Really? So I've got to remember that I
did do
well in some areas.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We have to reflect on both what went
right and
what caused the loss in order
to move forward,
right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's win the ne—no, I will win the next one!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So I can show everybody my best smile.
And so I
can enjoy the races even
more! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. I guess harsh feedback is just
what I need
right now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I'm just as responsible for
this loss.
I tell her that I've failed to draw
out her true
strength.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's not stand about moping! I
want to live
up to your expectations too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right, I won't lose anymore! Let's shoot
for the
stars!
